## Last-checked: 2026-09-10

# MailProcessor

Canonical repository: https://github.com/doc-bricks/MailProcessor
Verified status: 79/79 Pytest tests passing; source-platform smoke PASS
Organization: doc-bricks
Umbrella: open-bricks
Primary language: Python
UI stack: PySide6 desktop tray application
License: MIT

MailProcessor is the local-first Windows tray hub for the doc-bricks Universal Mail Tools:

- Universal Mail Cleaner: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalMailCleaner
- Universal Docs Grabber: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalDocsGrabber
- Universal Invoice Mail: https://github.com/doc-bricks/UniversalInvoiceMail

Core behavior:

- Starts configured mail tools from a single system tray menu.
- Scans sibling folders and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MailProcessor\tools\` for supported tools.
- Downloads latest tool releases from GitHub when users opt in through the setup wizard.
- Stores launcher configuration under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MailProcessor\config.json`.
- Exports a read-only `mailprocessor-suite-v1.json` snapshot for offline reference.
- Has no active web/PWA or Android/iOS companion; the former companion was deliberately removed after its use-case review.
- Maintains a source-level macOS/Linux contract only; no native package or end-user platform release is verified.
- Provides a read-only `store_readiness.py` CLI with text and JSON output; the
  Microsoft Store channel stays deferred until every integrity, FullTrust,
  privacy/support, MSIX, and WACK gate passes.

Visual architecture & diagrams:

- Dual Mermaid diagrams in README.md & README-DE.md:
  1. Component architecture flowchart (`flowchart TD`)
  2. End-to-end execution lifecycle sequence diagram (`sequenceDiagram`)
- All node labels and edge labels strictly quoted per HOOK-BANNER-ASSET-01.

Governance & runtime invariants:

- INV-LOCAL-01: 100% Local-First & Zero Egress
- INV-NOELEV-02: Non-Elevation & RunAsInvoker
- INV-ZIPSLIP-03: CWE-22 Zip-Slip Traversal Defense
- INV-CFGISO-04: Local AppData Isolation (%LOCALAPPDATA%\MailProcessor\config.json)
- INV-PROCLIF-05: Safe Subprocess Lifecycle (detached process spawn)
- INV-REDACT-06: Deterministic Snapshot Redaction (sanitized export)
- INV-OSPAR-07: Cross-Platform Source Smoke Contract (Ubuntu, macOS smoke)
- INV-SLA-08: Security Response & Triage SLA (48h acknowledgment, 5-day triage)

Privacy boundary:

- MailProcessor does not store mail contents, passwords, tokens, or IMAP credentials.
- Snapshot exports redact local paths and contain only launcher metadata.
- MailProcessor operates 100% local-first on the user's desktop with no remote cloud dependencies.

Local verification:

```bash
python -m pytest -q
python -m compileall .
```

## Audience

- Windows users running multiple Universal Mail Tools who want a single launch point
- Privacy-conscious home users and small business owners managing IMAP mail locally
- Developers building on top of the doc-bricks Universal Mail Tools suite
